name: 窓口アプリと役割群を備える会話のメンバー帳
prompt:
Create a second, corrected version of LH03-0155, matching the native Japanese preview exactly at a 390:580 canvas ratio. Preserve its clean mobile conversation-members screen and all authored Japanese text.

Keep the overall layout and wording from v001, but make these two corrections:
1. In the 「運営窓口」 app row, replace the avatar-like initial with the small green outline group/support pictogram shown in the native preview. It is an app icon, not a person avatar. Do not put a Japanese initial or member-status dot inside it.
2. Extend the lower white 「奉仕チーム — 3人」 member card down to the native preview's bottom boundary, leaving only the same small light-gray bottom margin. The card currently ends too early. Preserve the row positions and add only the missing lower card padding/height.

Keep the entire phrase 「運営への質問はこちら」 blue as the hyperlink, matching the separate blue-color reference. Keep all other wording and colors unchanged: dark-green active 「メンバー」 tab and underline; dark-green member names; pale-mint role pills; muted-gray section headings and subtext; gray timestamps if any. The search row remains 「会話内：一般」. The invite row remains 「メンバーを招待」 with the people icon and chevron.

Preserve exactly three member rows:
山田 はるか — 「受付」 and 「受付を担当します」
佐藤 ゆう — no subtitle or role
田中 あおい — 「音楽」
Keep the mint initial avatars 山, 佐, 田 on these member rows, with their native appearance. Use the native preview as authority for typography, spacing, card geometry, surface colors and all icon shapes. The Discord source provides semantic context only; do not copy its profile photos, channel chrome, badges or colors. Do not add people, text, decorations, extra controls, shadows or texture.

settings.hyperlinkText: 運営への質問はこちら

reviewNotes: 第2版を目視。運営窓口の人型アウトラインを修正し、3人の名簿・ロール・4タブ・招待入口と青い「運営への質問はこちら」を保持。下部メンバーカードはnativeと近い高さ/下余白へ修正。残差はnativeのアプリ記号の淡いミント円形背景が欠落し、白面上に緑線画が直接載っていること。2回の限定試行を保存しneeds-correctionのまま次IDへ進む。所有者受入・ネイティブ編集・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
